content:
devon: noticed apiserver error surge in asia-south around 09:07 UTC, lots of 500/503s. controller-manager leader election chatter. anyone on it?

riley: jumping in. etcd leader metrics show write stall spikes and raft heartbeats delayed. storage device iowait on etcd-primary high.

amar: correlating with provisioner attach waterfall: a single deploy tried to attach ~90 GPUs across pods -> attach retries + short TCP sessions. SNAT exhaustion flagged by edge-proxies.

sam: conntrack count on proxy nodes hit 95% of configured max, many CLOSE_WAIT/ESTABLISHED short sockets. NAT pools exhausted -> kube-apiserver control plane requests stalled.

devon: that would explain etcd WAL fsync bursts. storage backend getting hammered by many small metadata writes. leader slowed -> quorum lag -> apiserver request timeouts.
riley: logs snippet: ```
2026-03-21T09:06:58Z etcdserver: committed entry took too long [310.112ms]
2026-03-21T09:07:02Z WAL writer: fsync latency 340ms
2026-03-21T09:07:05Z raft: warning: election timeout increased
```

amar: autoscaler config permitted large concurrent attaches (maxConcurrency: 60). planner didn't shard rollouts by region. rollout was global.
sam: immediate mitigations I applied: 1) disabled remaining attach workers in provisioner (graceful stop), 2) scaled up two egress nodes to add SNAT capacity, 3) bumped net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max on proxies.

riley: I also moved etcd leader to a node with lower IO by forcing leader transfer (etcdctl move-leader). leader moved and fsync latencies dropped.
devon: controller-manager had ~4 restarts during spike; kube-scheduler backlog increased. Confirmed pods in Pending due to attach timeouts.

amar: paused the rollout in CI and cancelled remaining attach jobs. added an emergency flag to reduce attach concurrency to 10.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-1995 created for asia-south control plane instability. Pager: @oncall-sre.

sam: watch: apiserver 5xx rate down from 120/s -> 4/s in 90s after changes. etcd WAL fsync p95 down from 340ms -> 45ms.
riley: note cost: fallback attach to eu-west kicked a few attempts earlier which generated cross-region traffic; estimate extra egress ~$3.1k. recording to billing incident.
devon: action items (short): keep provisioner concurrency low; rotate leader to low-IO node if WAL spike detected; autoscale SNAT sooner (sam).
amar: mid-term: change deploy planner to stagger regional attaches, add jitter/backoff to provisioner, add pre-check for SNAT capacity before rollout.
sam: long-term: add control-plane circuit-breaker that rejects new attach transactions when etcd WAL latency crosses threshold. also add watch for conntrack high-water triggers.
riley: opened follow-ups: GH-5710 (provisioner: region sharding + jitter), GH-5711 (runbook: etcd WAL spike playbook), GH-5712 (network: conntrack autoscale).
devon: thanks — leaving throttles enforced and monitoring for 30m. tagging this P2; will convert to P1 if errors return. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: auto: deploy pipeline paused, cancelled 12 remaining attach jobs.

sre-bot: update: incident assigned to devon. timeline entry added.

amar: planning postmortem draft; will include timeline, graphs (etcd WAL, conntrack, SNAT), and cost impact.

sam: +1, keep channel updated if any regressions.

devon: closing loop here for now, will ping when postmortem ready.
